WTO | Community - Debates WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION Home | About WTO | News & events | Trade topics | WTO membership | Documents & resources | External relations Contact us | Site map | A-Z | Search español français home community debates WTO Forum A series of webcasting debates where experts from around the world confront major issues facing the WTO and the multilateral trading system. Visitors to the WTO website can join an online discussion on the subject of the debate. The debates will be held on a regular basis, with advance notices for  subjects and dates posted on the WTO website.
